zh.title: 達美航空波音737-900ER引擎故障緊急返航亞特蘭大
zh.summary: 達美航空波音737客機右側引擎故障返航亞特蘭大；造成航班延誤
body: 根據航空新聞媒體 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空（Delta Air Lines）一架波音 737-900ER 客機因右側發動機出現異常故障，被迫立即返回亞特蘭大。該起發動機問題發生後，客機暫時停止服務，對達美航空在亞特蘭大繁忙的樞紐機場營運造成考驗。
報導指出，該架客機因右側引擎故障返航後，導致班機延誤，受影響的旅客只能在現場等待後續處置。目前相關報導並未提供該班機的具體航班號碼、發動機故障原因或詳細的後續維修維護進度。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Boeing 737-900ER Returns To Atlanta After Engine Issue
en.summary: Delta Air Lines Boeing 737-900ER returns to Atlanta after right engine glitch; operations disrupted and passengers delayed.
body: A Boeing 737-900ER aircraft operated by Delta Air Lines was forced to make an immediate return to Atlanta after experiencing an engine issue, according to aviation news outlet Simple Flying. The occurrence involved a technical glitch affecting the aircraft's right engine shortly after operation, prompting the crew to return to the airport.

The unscheduled return tested Delta Air Lines' busy hub operations in Atlanta and resulted in delays for passengers on board the flight, who were left waiting following the aircraft's out-of-service status. No further details regarding flight numbers or official maintenance findings were disclosed in the source report.
